spans.value: 90% de las hortalizas de hoja que se consumen en América del Norte durante el invierno

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both sources state that the Yuma, Arizona region produces approximately 90% of the leafy greens/vegetables consumed in North America during the winter. The Spanish and English versions are equivalent in meaning.

edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: The two quotes provide the same figure (40 million people) in different languages. While they likely share an origin, the quotes themselves do not explicitly state it.

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes state the population of Cave Creek is about 5,000 people. One is in Spanish ('unas 5.000 personas') and the other in English ('about 5,000 people'). They refer to the same figure.

edges.sentence: On 2026-08-29, PBS NewsHour reported “But Cave Creek Mayor Robert Morris can't shake the real possibility that it's not enough to keep the desert community of about 5,000 people afloat well into the future.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Pero el alcalde de Cave Creek, Robert Morris, no puede eludir la posibilidad real de que eso no sea suficiente para mantener a flote, en el futuro, a la comunidad desértica de unas 5.000 personas.”.

On 2026-08-29, PBS NewsHour reported “Cave Creek gets nearly all of its water from the river, which serves 40 million people across the U.S. West and has been dwindling because of climate change, demand and overuse.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Cave Creek obtiene casi toda su agua del río, que abastece a 40 millones de personas en el oeste de Estados Unidos y ha ido disminuyendo por el cambio climático, la demanda y el uso excesivo.”.

On 2026-08-29, PBS NewsHour reported “John Boelts grows vegetables, melons, durum wheat and other crops in Yuma, Arizona — a region that produces about 90% of leafy greens eaten in North America during the winter.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “Yuma, Arizona, una región que produce alrededor del 90% de las hortalizas de hoja que se consumen en América del Norte durante el invierno.”.
